t: These Saxby CosmosEco V3 Fixed Fire-Rated LED Recessed Downlights offer a practical and efficient lighting solution for various indoor environments. Designed for both domestic and commercial applications, they are ideal for kitchens, bathrooms, and corridors due to their IP65 rating and cool white 4000K light. The dimmable downlights feature a convenient 4-way, screwless push-fit terminal block, ensuring fast and straightforward installation with a standard 57mm holesaw. With a long 50,000-hour life and durable steel body, these integrated LED fittings provide reliable and low-maintenance illumination.
